description:
The best leveraged ETF for one ticker, both directions, flat: give a stock
(NVDA, TSLA), an index or sector ETF (QQQ, SPY, SOXX, XLE, GLD, TLT, FXI) or any
leveraged fund ticker (SOXL), and get back:
  bull: the most liquid leveraged LONG fund {symbol, leverage, avgDollarVolumeUsd, watchOnly}
  bear: the leveraged SHORT / inverse fund (same fields plus pairedWith), or null if none
  otherBull / otherBear: the remaining funds on that underlying, most liquid first.
Pass leverage=2 or 3 to get the most liquid fund at exactly that multiple ("the
best 2x on NVDA", "is there a 3x short on gold"). "Best" = highest 20-session
average daily dollar volume, except that bear prefers bull's same-issuer inverse
(SPXL / SPXS) when it trades at least half as much as the most liquid bear. Leveraged and inverse funds reset daily and decay
when held: an instrument lookup, not a trade call.

leverage.description: Optional: only funds at exactly 2x or 3x

symbol.description: Stock, ETF, index or leveraged-fund ticker, e.g. NVDA, QQQ, SOXX, GLD, SOXL

name: get_leveraged_etf_pick
title: Get Leveraged ETF Pick
